test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The trio of women at the table ________ representative of the enormous flux of American life.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'was'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "The trio of women" is a collective noun that is singular in form and takes a singular verb.
 
• Even though "women" is plural, the subject "trio" is singular, necessitating a singular verb form.
 
• The context of the sentence suggests a simple past tense scenario.
 
• "Was" correctly matches the singular collective noun "trio" and the simple past tense context.
 
• Using "was" makes the sentence clear and grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (had being): Grammatically incorrect; the phrase "had being" is not a valid verb form.
 
• Option 3 (has been): Incorrect tense; "has been" is present perfect, not consistent with the simple past needed here.
 
• Option 4 (were): Incorrect verb form; "were" is plural, whereas "trio" is singular.
